issues.item: Triggers: Sexual Trauma Cues: Comments on sexual violence
issues.explanation: For a mugging or robbery trauma, 'comments on sexual violence' is a hard-to-explain trigger unless there is unreported sexual victimization; it is not clinically coherent with the stated trauma type and the rest of the profile, which centers on threat/vigilance and injustice after robbery.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Lost Emotions: I will never be able to feel normal emotions again
issues.explanation: 'I will never be able to feel normal emotions again' is a broad, severe numbing/permanent-change appraisal that is weakly supported by the rest of the selected items, which otherwise focus on danger, vigilance, sensory memory, and injustice/accountability. It does not directly contradict them, but in this profile it stands out as insufficiently linked to the active edge pattern and selected nodes.

issues.item: No Coherent Story: I cannot tell a clear story of what happened even to myself
issues.explanation: The memory profile mixes vivid sensory re-experiencing (auditory recall, pain recall) with a severe disorganization claim ('cannot tell a clear story even to myself'). While not impossible, for a single-incident mugging this level of global narrative incoherence is the least coherent item in the node and is harder to reconcile with the otherwise specific, sensory memory content.
No Maladaptive Strategies items were provided, so the required five-component self-report profile is incomplete and cannot be fully evaluated for coherence across all specified components.
